Mayor Patrick Collins provided information related to recent national and international (public)
event incidents involving the use of vehicles as weapons and emphasized the importance of
insuring public safety at similar types of events in the City. Captain Jared Keslar provided
additional information. All committee members commented on the item.

       e)     Consideration to purchase between the City of Cheyenne and Ace Equipment &
              Supply Company, for the purchase of two (2) sets of Rotary Mobile-Column Lifting
              Systems. (Fleet Maintenance Fund & Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Esquibel moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $185,878.00, seconded by Mr. Moody.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report.

       f)     Consideration of Bid #S-17-25 for an agreement between the City of Cheyenne and
              JTL Group Inc. d/b/a Knife River, for the 2025 City Overlay #1 Project. (2023-
              2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund)

Mr. Esquibel moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $1,349,869.00, seconded by Mr.
Roybal. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Doug Klahn, Construction Manager, provided a staff report and committee member Esquibel
commented on the item.

       g)     Consideration of Bid #S-18-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and Miller & Sons Construction Inc. for the 2025 Miscellaneous Concrete Project.
              (2023-2026 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund)

Mr. Esquibel moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $642,479.86, seconded by Mr. Moody.
Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Doug Klahn, Construction Manager, provided a staff report and committee members Moody and
Roybal commented on the item.

       h)     Consideration of Bid #S-2 1-25 for an Agreement between the City of Cheyenne
              and T C Solutions, LLC, for the Christensen Road Modifications: Drainage,
              Signage and Lighting Project. (2017 Specific Purpose Option Tax Fund)

Mr. Esquibel moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $566,299.00, seconded by Mr.
Roybal. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Tom Cobb, City Engineer, provided a staff report and committee member Esquibel commented on
the item.
